chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Charlie Gaines's band and Louis Jordan
summary: Louis Jordan came out of Charlie Gaines's entertaining nine-piece Philadelphia band before going to Chick Webb.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, sure. Louis Jordan came from there. That great band, was a little nine-piece band, Charlie Gaines, that Louis Jordan came from that band. The band used to sing. They used to sing harmony and different things like that, you know. It was a very entertaining band.

But Louis is the only -- Charlie Gaines himself, I knew him. He was a trumpet player and I knew Louis. I didn't know the rest of the guys too well. But Louis Jordan, he left there to go to Chick Webb.

Uh-huh. You got any more trumpet players on your list that you could probably -- guys that really contributed. We've mentioned Louis Bacon, we've mentioned Starks, we've mentioned the Smiths, we've mentioned --
Uh-huh, and, yeah, I should have mentioned Freddie Jenkins.
